at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0003.title: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes
at-0003.content: Validation failures in ledgerly/invoice.py raise BillingError with a stable code string and a repr() of the offending value, e.g. BillingError("invalid_quantity", repr(quantity)) or BillingError("negative_amount", repr(unit_price)); reuse existing codes like invalid_state for status checks.

at-0004.content: When validating integer inputs in ledgerly, guard with `isinstance(x, bool) or not isinstance(x, int)` because Python bools are ints and True would otherwise pass a positive-integer check.
